rules: An item is a Template, a Rating (1-5 for Enhancement, Ward and Reservoir; DECISIONS.md) and any number of Descriptors. Descriptors never change the Rating. Enhancement and Ward values equal the Rating (DECISIONS.md). Items stack with weapon quality.

templates.name: Enhancement
templates.summary: Adds to a roll you were already making.
templates.grants: +1 / +2 / +3 to one named Skill, Attack, Deflect, Defend, or Ability Score.
templates.rating: Rating 1-5 = +1 to +5 (the bonus equals the Rating). Only the highest Enhancement to a given roll applies; they do not stack with each other.
templates.examples: Flame Tongue, Belt of Giant Strength, Headband of Intellect, Bracers of Defense, Cloak of Protection, weapon and armor runes

templates.name: Ward
templates.grants: DR against one damage source, resistance to one Effect type, or immunity to one named Condition.
templates.rating: Rating 1-5 = DR 1-5 (DR equals the Rating). Instead of DR: halve one Effect type (Rating 1+), immunity to one Condition (Rating 3+), or immunity to one Effect type entirely (Rating 5).
templates.examples: Adamantine Armor, Dragon Scale Mail, Ring of Free Action, Periapt of Wound Closure, Brooch of Shielding, Necklace of Adaptation

templates.name: Reservoir
templates.summary: Holds Powers or Effects and spends them as charges.
templates.grants: A number of charges equal to Rating, refreshing at dawn or on a Full Rest. Each charge casts a stored Power at a fixed Power Level, or applies a stored Effect.
templates.rating: Rating 1 = 1 charge, PL 1 · Rating 3 = 3 charges, PL 3 · Rating 5 = 5 charges, PL 5. The wielder does not need the Cast skill; the item supplies the roll at 10 + Rating.
templates.examples: Wand of Fireballs, Staff of Healing, Ring of Spell Storing, Necklace of Fireballs, Horn of Blasting, staves and wands generally

templates.name: Faculty
templates.summary: Grants a capability the character did not previously have.
templates.grants: One named ability: a movement mode, a sense, a form of access, or a means of carrying, communicating, or perceiving.
templates.rating: Faculties have no Rating — you either have the capability or you do not. Some carry a per-scene or per-session limit, noted on the item.
templates.examples: Winged Boots, Bag of Holding, Goggles of Night, Ring of Water Walking, Amulet of the Planes, Decanter of Endless Water, Crystal Ball

templates.name: Reserve
templates.summary: Once per session, decisively changes one outcome.
templates.grants: Negate a hit, reroll any roll, auto-succeed at one Check, escape any Condition, or undo one consequence. Declared after the result is known.
templates.rating: Reserve items have no Rating and no charges — one use, refreshing at session end. A character may benefit from only one Reserve item per session regardless of how many they carry.
templates.examples: Luck Blade, Stone of Good Luck, Ring of Evasion, Rod of Security, Deck of Many Things, Elder Sign

descriptors.name: Mithral
descriptors.effect: Weightless. Removes any encumbrance or Stealth penalty the item would impose.

descriptors.name: Adamantine
descriptors.effect: Cannot be broken by ordinary means. Ignores DR 1 when used as a weapon.

descriptors.name: Cold Iron
descriptors.effect: +2 damage against fae, and Fae Bargain effects cannot target the bearer.

descriptors.name: Silvered
descriptors.effect: +2 damage against lycanthropes and their wounds do not close.

descriptors.name: Obsidian
descriptors.effect: +2 damage against the incorporeal; shatters on a Natural 1.

descriptors.name: Bone
descriptors.effect: Cheap and unsettling. −1 to social rolls where it is visible.

descriptors.name: Living Wood
descriptors.effect: Repairs itself over a Full Rest. Cannot be enchanted with Fire.

descriptors.name: Starmetal
descriptors.effect: Ignores Ward effects of Rating 1. Rare beyond reckoning.

descriptors.name: Elven
descriptors.effect: Silent and light. +1 to Stealth while carried.

descriptors.name: Dwarven
descriptors.effect: Bonus applies to Endure as well as its named use.

descriptors.name: Draconic
descriptors.effect: Carries one elemental Effect type at no additional cost.

descriptors.name: Celestial
descriptors.effect: Radiant Effect type. Cannot be wielded at Corruption 3 or higher.

descriptors.name: Fiendish
descriptors.effect: Void Effect type. Grants +1 Rating but adds Corruption +1 on first use.

descriptors.name: Fae
descriptors.effect: Its benefit is real and its terms are not stated. GM defines one condition.

descriptors.name: Ancient
descriptors.effect: Predates the current age. Once per session it does something nobody expected.

descriptors.name: Improvised
descriptors.effect: Made in the field. Rating 1 maximum; breaks on a Natural 1.

descriptors.name: Sentient
descriptors.effect: Has goals. Willpower check vs DC 13 to act against them while attuned.

descriptors.name: Attuned
descriptors.effect: Only one character may benefit. Reattuning takes a Full Rest.

descriptors.name: Bound
descriptors.effect: Cannot be dropped, sold, or given away while its condition holds.

descriptors.name: Consuming
descriptors.effect: Costs 1 box from a named pool each time its benefit is used.

descriptors.name: Waning
descriptors.effect: Rating drops by 1 each time a Natural 1 is rolled while using it.

descriptors.name: Conditional
descriptors.effect: Works only under a stated circumstance — moonlight, on holy ground, at sea.

descriptors.name: Loud
descriptors.effect: Its use is obvious and unmistakable to anyone watching.

descriptors.name: Cursed
descriptors.effect: The benefit is real. So is the drawback, and it is not disclosed.

genre_items.name: Bag of Tricks

genre_items.name: Figurine of Wondrous Power
genre_items.text: Statuette becomes a loyal mount or guardian.

genre_items.name: Deck of Many Things
genre_items.text: Draw once. The GM decides what you have done.

genre_items.name: Horn of Valhalla
genre_items.text: 3 charges. Each summons spectral warriors for a scene.

genre_items.name: Instrument of the Bards
genre_items.text: +2 to Persuade and Inspire when performed.

genre_items.name: Ioun Stone
genre_items.text: Orbits the head. +1 to one Ability Score, never removed.

genre_items.name: Robe of the Archmagi
genre_items.text: DR 2 and +2 against hostile Powers.

genre_items.name: Rod of Lordly Might
genre_items.text: Becomes six different weapons and tools on command.

genre_items.name: Manual of Bodily Health
genre_items.text: Read over a month. One Ability Score +1, permanently.

genre_items.name: Portable Hole
genre_items.text: A hole you fold up and carry. Ten feet deep.

genre_items.name: Iron Nail
genre_items.text: Immunity to Possessed while held. Rusts away after one use.

genre_items.name: Cursed Locket
genre_items.text: +2 to a chosen Ability Score. Affliction advances one stage per session worn.

genre_items.name: Hunting Journal
genre_items.text: +2 Knowledge about any creature recorded in it.

genre_items.name: The Photograph That Changes
genre_items.text: Shows the truth of a place, updating without being touched.

genre_items.name: Grave Dirt

genre_items.name: Bell, Book and Candle
genre_items.text: 3 charges of Abjure at Rating 4 against the possessing.

genre_items.name: Rope of the Hanged
genre_items.text: Binds the incorporeal as though it were solid.

genre_items.name: Last Rites Kit
genre_items.text: Once per session, deny one death its aftermath.

genre_items.name: Mythos Tome
genre_items.text: +3 Knowledge (Mythos). Each reading costs 1 Sanity permanently.

genre_items.name: Elder Sign
genre_items.text: Immunity to one named Mythos entity's direct attention.

genre_items.name: Shining Trapezohedron

genre_items.name: Nitroglycerin

genre_items.name: Field Notes

genre_items.name: Star-Stone

genre_items.name: Burner Phone
genre_items.text: One clean line of contact. Discard after use.

genre_items.name: Prescription Bottle
genre_items.text: 5 doses. Each suppresses one Condition for a scene.

genre_items.name: Press Credentials
genre_items.text: Access to places that would otherwise refuse you.

genre_items.name: Unmarked Van
genre_items.text: Mobile base, surveillance platform, and exit.

genre_items.name: Cash, Untraceable
genre_items.text: Solves problems money solves. No paper trail.

genre_items.name: Legal Retainer

genre_items.name: Police Scanner
genre_items.text: You hear it coming before it arrives.

genre_items.name: Dead Drop Key

genre_items.name: Micro Camera

genre_items.name: Handler Contact

genre_items.name: Wire Recorder

genre_items.name: Forged Seal

genre_items.name: Poisoned Pen
genre_items.text: 3 doses, delivered by handshake or signature.

genre_items.name: Neural Interface

genre_items.name: Reflex Booster

genre_items.name: Monowire

genre_items.name: Cortex Bomb

genre_items.name: Clockwork Arm
genre_items.text: +2 Strength for one named use. Winds down after a scene.

genre_items.name: Difference Engine
genre_items.text: Given a Task Block, computes what no person could.

genre_items.name: Aetheric Compass

genre_items.name: Automaton Servant

genre_items.name: Phlogiston Cell

genre_items.name: Calculating Monocle

genre_items.name: Tricorder

genre_items.name: Transporter Tag

genre_items.name: Data Padd

genre_items.name: Diplomatic Credentials

genre_items.name: Sensor Drone

genre_items.name: Peacemaker

genre_items.name: Dowsing Rod

genre_items.name: Snake Oil

genre_items.name: Sure-Footed Horse

genre_items.name: Dynamite

genre_items.name: Wanted Poster

genre_items.name: Medicine Bundle

genre_items.name: An Ace Up the Sleeve
genre_items.text: Once per session, the odds were never what they seemed.

genre_items.name: Dueling Rapier
genre_items.text: +2 Combat (Melee). Riposte costs no Reaction once per scene.

genre_items.name: Plague Mask
genre_items.text: Immunity to disease. Nobody meets your eye.

genre_items.name: Alchemist's Lens
genre_items.text: Identify any substance given an uninterrupted minute.

genre_items.name: Papal Writ
genre_items.text: Once per session, authority overrules whatever stands in the way.

genre_items.name: Poisoner's Ring
genre_items.text: 3 doses delivered by touch, drink, or handshake.

genre_items.name: Astrolabe
genre_items.text: +2 Navigate and +2 Knowledge on celestial matters.

genre_items.name: Banker's Letter
genre_items.text: Credit in any city with a counting house.

genre_items.name: Warded Candle
genre_items.text: While lit, the unnatural cannot cross its light.

genre_items.name: Named Blade
genre_items.text: +2 Combat (Melee). The name carries obligations.

genre_items.name: Golden Pill
genre_items.text: 3 doses. Each restores 4 boxes and advances cultivation.

genre_items.name: Qiankun Pouch
genre_items.text: Holds a mountain. Weighs nothing.

genre_items.name: Sealed Technique
genre_items.text: Once per session, a form you swore never to use again.

genre_items.name: Iron Shirt Cultivation
genre_items.text: DR 2. Requires daily practice or it fades.

genre_items.name: Lightness Skill
genre_items.text: Run on water, roof tiles, and bamboo tips.

genre_items.name: Sect Token
genre_items.text: Recognition, shelter, and enemies you inherited.

genre_items.name: Manual of the Ancients
genre_items.text: +1 to one Ability Score after a month of study.

genre_items.name: God-Forged Spear
genre_items.text: +3 Combat (Melee). Cannot be broken by mortal means.

genre_items.name: Aegis Fragment
genre_items.text: DR 3 and immunity to Frightened.

genre_items.name: Winged Sandals
genre_items.text: Flight at will, as easily as walking.

genre_items.name: Horn of Plenty

genre_items.name: Thread of Fate

genre_items.name: Ambrosia
genre_items.text: 3 doses. Each restores all pools completely.

genre_items.name: Oracle's Sight
genre_items.text: One honest answer per session about what is coming.

genre_items.name: Divine Favor
genre_items.text: A god is watching. This is not entirely good news.

text: A player asks for an item you have not written. Four questions settle it.

If an item does two things, it is two items in one object — price it at the higher Rating plus one. If it does three, it is an artifact and should have a name, a history, and somebody who wants it back.

questions.question: Does it already exist as a Universal Item?
questions.decides: If three or more genres would want it, it is Universal. Give it the local name and move on.

questions.question: Which of the five shapes is it?
questions.decides: Enhancement, Ward, Reservoir, Faculty, or Reserve.

questions.question: How strong, 1 to 5?
questions.decides: The Rating. Match it to the Power Level the party could already reach — an item should not outrun the tier.

questions.question: What makes it interesting to own?
questions.decides: One or two Descriptors. This is where the item stops being a number and becomes a thing.
